models.name: Model G
models.summary: Introduced in 1936 in "monofilm" and "multifilm" models; the multifilm included a tool-free parts kit of reel spindles, sprockets, gate and guide-rollers to adapt the projector to various film gauges.
Projected 8mm film at fixed speeds of 18 and 5 frames per second forward, and 18 fps in reverse.

models.name: M-8
models.summary: Designed to run off a mains power supply of 110–125 Volts.

models.name: SM 8
models.summary: Magnetic sound projection and recording, with a built-in 2W / 15 Ohm speaker.

models.name: S-221
models.summary: Plays back silent or sound film with optical or magnetic tracks, and records sound onto 16mm magnetic-striped film.
